summary: Architectural plan to strictly decouple the Cohort Peer Chat (/chat) from the 1-on-1 AI Tutor Workspace (/tutor). Restores the multi-student collaborative room with peer channels, presence indicators, and AI co-moderator in /chat. Overhauls the Tutor Workspace drawer in /tutor to match the Gemini mobile drawer with dynamic session history from useTutorStore, live transcript search, pin toggles, subject hubs, and user profile footer without any hardcoded session entries.
